# Acquired continuing dependency after component completion

6 October 2026. AI-authored continuation following [Ren’s direction](../../../../sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-10-06-remaining-dependency-continuation.md), under the [shared method](../../../../theories/shengsheng-buxi-generative-existence/unified-2026-10-05/NONDUAL-METHOD.md). **Complete at the declared native and formal scope:** independent reconstruction accepts27 ancestry-compatible cases, with one rejected-ancestry fixture preserved separately; the fresh Lean build passes43 substantive theorem audits and446 generated correspondence certificates. The [preceding inquiry-completion result](INQUIRY-COMPLETION-INTEGRATION.md) remains completed at its own scope.

## The connection being tested

The target is **acquired continuing dependency → revision of the relation that must be maintained → actual subsequent activity**. A completed productive event remains completed. The question is whether a further independently described activity requires maintaining a particular enabling relation, and whether the learner can acquire and act on that dependency.

This extends an actual retained endpoint of the existing learner. It is a prospective addition to the local transition law; it does not pretend that the earlier native apparatus already had the new relay, diagnostic port or later-load contract. No old result is replaced, and the original endowment is not reset. The broader undertaking is specified independently of which relay setting the acquired evidence will support. Its ethical warrant and ultimate origin are not derived by the assay.

Activity, retained consequences, the observation route, maintained relay and later load are differentiated relations within one history. The analysis separates diagnostic response from its acquired indication, and both from the later full-load event, because erasing those distinctions would conceal contact failures or credit an unperformed action. The supplied local law is not thereby outside generative reality; the particular formation and calibration it represents remain premises of this model.

## Prospective contrast

An actual low-power challenge is performed with the relay open and with it closed. Its two outcomes describe an operational relation rather than an instruction naming a new goal:

| Response with relay off/on | Relation disclosed under the declared calibration | Supported setting for the later load |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 0/1 | The load depends on the relay being maintained. | On. |
| 1/0 | The relay obstructs the load. | Off. |
| 1/1 | The load works with either setting. | Off under the supplied lower-maintenance preference. |
| 0/0 | Neither tested setting supports the load. | No supported setting in this family. |

The [prospective protocol](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/mathematical-abstraction/acquisition/feedback/REMAINING-DEPENDENCY-PROTOCOL.md) fixes the law, all cases, tariff and scope before execution. The final row does not erase the undertaking or establish that no response could ever work. Incomplete evidence also remains unresolved. The 0/1 and 1/0 cases have disjoint adequate settings, whereas 1/1 has a common adequate response with either case. This prevents a blanket inference that every change in circumstances must change the chosen action.

More precisely, let \(R_f=\{r\in\{0,1\}:f(r)=1\}\). The same completed parent history is compatible with \(R_{01}=\{1\}\) and \(R_{10}=\{0\}\). Its completion information alone cannot determine a single adequate setting across both. Acquiring the two correctly bound responses identifies the relevant relation within the declared family. A full pair is sufficient for this identification; it is not a theorem that every adequate action needs both probes. The fixed assay and lower-maintenance tie-break remain supplied.

The diagnostic challenges do not consume the final source packet or fulfill the later full-load contract. A separate subsequent operation must enact the retained choice, debit the actual source and produce its own consequence. Correspondence between diagnostic and full-load behavior is an explicit local assumption with a failure comparison. A false or stale report can support an inappropriate setting without changing the actual dependency.

## Closure contract

The continuation must carry the original learner, acquired table, prior component fulfillment and actual remaining resources into the new sequence. Contrasting settings and acquired outcomes must be bound in the record. A matched intervention must retain that record and its acquisition costs while disconnecting its influence on the subsequent requirement. Full-load outcomes, unavailable source and unsuccessful contact must remain visible in the same account.

Independent reconstruction and the checked formal suffix correspondence below satisfy that contract at its stated scope. This does not claim a new proof of the entire inherited learner. Generic method formation, inquiry revision, acquired applicability and learned stopping remain credited; this study does not rename them as previously absent capacities.

## Actual outcomes and independent reconstruction

The [native implementation and mechanism](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/mathematical-abstraction/acquisition/feedback/REMAINING-DEPENDENCY-MECHANISM.md) start at the retained primary endpoint: H110, phase table `[0,1,unknown]`, fuel `178253/16384`, source10 and26 retained cells. The new interface forms eight bounded registers, with explicit formation, work, rewriting, retention and relay-hold charges. These are implementation envelopes, not measurements of physical RAM or universal costs. The acquired outcomes enter the actual retained setting used by a distinct subsequent load transfer.

| Native relation | Acquired pair | Enacted result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Relay-dependent | `[0,1]` | Retain/hold relay; transfer source10 to load10. |
| Relay-obstructed | `[1,0]` | Release relay; transfer source10 to load10. |
| Relay-independent | `[1,1]` | Select the supplied lower-maintenance bypass; transfer source10 to load10. |
| Neither setting productive | `[0,0]` | Retain the absence of a supported route; leave source10 unused. |
| Matched old-stop consumer | Same acquired pairs as corresponding ordinary runs | Preserve the records and assay/read/commit costs; do not issue the later transfer. |

The dependent positive case ends with actor fuel `214009/32768`; the obstructed and independent cases end with `222201/32768`. The full-load destination is distinct from actor fuel: every suffix has zero actor income. The exact original account retains prior irreversible consumption and adds new expenditure, remaining actor fuel, remaining source, delivered load and wasted source to total145. Final load fulfillment is a physical/audit fact. No final outcome indication is acquired, so the learner is not credited with diagnosing its own final success or a calibration failure.

An ordinary finite-state lookup consuming the same pair matches the learned consumer’s entire saved result under all four laws. The acquired dependency connection is the result; no advantage over ordinary feedback control is established. A supplied-law controller or an earlier-exiting query policy would have different informational or procedural premises; the present two-test schedule is not claimed uniquely necessary or optimal.

Missing or misbound contacts remain unknown. False bits can select a route that wastes the final packet, or falsely suppress a productive route. Weak/full-load mismatch and changed service context preserve accurate old probe records while defeating their application to the later operation. The actually reached `later_ten` parent has no remaining source: its correct acquired choice cannot execute the final transfer. Waiting consumes real retained fuel and exposes separate contact, writing, installation and retention failures. An unfulfilled parent is refused by the existing controller-location/retention guard; hidden physical fulfillment is not used as a runtime oracle.

The [independent review](REMAINING-DEPENDENCY-REVIEW.md) reconstructs all28 saved conditional suffixes:362 state points and325 charged events. Its inherited check covers three actual parent histories,66 inquiry events and276 acquisition/first-use event occurrences. Shared prefixes are reused evidence, not independent empirical observations. Nineteen source bindings and seven targeted corruption tests are checked. The new suffix checker does not import the producer’s transition implementation; its reuse of the earlier independent ancestry checker is disclosed.

### A rejected prospective case remains preserved

The original protocol included a capacity40 alternative declared from the beginning, relying on the inquiry stage’s peak33. Root inspection found that the earlier acquisition actually reaches peak114. That alternative therefore cannot realize the same full ancestor. The [explicit erratum](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/mathematical-abstraction/acquisition/feedback/REMAINING-DEPENDENCY-ERRATUM.md) preserves the first protocol, source and result bytes and rejects its ancestry claim. No capacity-drop law, additional support or revised prices were introduced to rescue it.

The accepted count is **27 ancestry-compatible cases**, including the deliberately denied unfulfilled parent, plus **one rejected-ancestry conditional suffix test**. The rejected test still checks the local installation guard at an assumed capacity40 cut; it is not a reached continuation of the declared original history. The current interface’s peak42 is likewise a suffix peak, not the lifetime peak of the inherited learner. This correction changes the accepted scope rather than erasing the failed proposal.

## Lean result and correspondence scope

[RemainingDependency.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/mathematical-abstraction/acquisition/feedback/remaining-dependency/formal/RemainingDependency.lean) adds43 substantive theorem audits. It proves charge and source/destination conservation, preservation of the complete inherited coordinate, truthful bound-evidence selection, absence of one constant setting adequate to the opposed01/10 relations, conditional calibrated transfer, and the actual funded primary, opposed and clamped continuations. Missing or corrupt evidence and broken calibration have explicit adverse statements.

The [fresh checker and receipt](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/mathematical-abstraction/acquisition/feedback/remaining-dependency/formal/verification.json) translate the frozen saved suffix states into exact integer units of1/65536 and prove446 generated correspondence, trace and account certificates. They cover362 states,334 saved edges,325 successful charges and all eight denial reasons/guards. Of the edges,333 are operation requests and one is an entrance denial. Eighteen unchanged inherited core audits are replayed separately; the total507 is not507 new mathematical discoveries. All dependencies are disclosed standard `propext`/`Quot.sound` where nonempty, with no custom axioms, proof placeholders or native-evaluation proof shortcuts. The pinned Lean4.29.1 build uses fresh local sources and preserves logs, input snapshots, generated statements and hashes.

The general Lean transition law represents **event attempts**. A denied request leaves its state unchanged; arbitrary request words need not follow the Python controller’s schedule. Its generic core-trace theorem therefore does not itself establish funding or universal executor equivalence. Exact saved transitions, explicit denial guards, the nominal funded protocol theorems and independent native reconstruction establish the reported cases. The original sensory-learning history is checked through its existing source-bound independent reconstruction, not silently re-proved by an imported endpoint. The capacity40 fixture remains conditional local arithmetic throughout.

## Scope of the theoretical contribution

The intended addition is a distinction between completing a component and discharging every continuing requirement. An acquired model of a surviving dependency can revise what must remain organized for the next activity while preserving the earlier achievement. The local model can investigate that connection without deriving the worth of every possible undertaking.

Appropriate continuation can require either retaining or releasing a tested arrangement. In the relay-dependent case, retaining the relation supports the later activity; in the obstructive case, releasing it does. This gives the systems integration a concrete test of which organization should persist relative to an independently specified effect. Mere persistence or change does not settle that relation. A failure of the diagnostic/full-load correspondence would restrict the acquired model’s application even if its record of the earlier probes remained accurate.

The whole-process foundation still has to justify its comparisons among differentiated realization, impairment and repair. Neither a successful relay nor transfer of support establishes another participant’s standing or a universal ethical priority. Any accepted result here must enter that larger account at its actual causal and evidential scope.

## Relation to the concurrent material-dependency study

The concurrent [material continuation](CONTINUING-DEPENDENCY-INTEGRATION.md) derives a distinct relation from its unchanged event law: equal completed reconstruction and equal total support can leave different later repair possibilities because common fuel and inaccessible source occupy different roles. Its [identification interface](CONTINUING-DEPENDENCY-IDENTIFICATION.md) requires actual acquisition within that material history. At its one-common-unit boundary, installing an additional reader can consume the support needed for the later repair; an imported source-to-common replenishment rule would change the obstruction being investigated.

The relay study begins at the different, actually retained inquiry endpoint and declares its new product law prospectively. It neither changes the material branch’s law nor supplies its missing reader. The two studies answer complementary questions: one characterizes a native surviving dependency and its material acquisition constraint; the other tests an explicit acquired-dependency/use connection in a specified continuation of the existing inquiry history. Joining them would require a new actual correspondence and support account. Their shared terminology is not that correspondence.

The next connection is acquisition and use of such a dependency under the specific material history’s formation and support constraints, or acquired revision of a failed diagnostic/application correspondence using actual later consequences. Those are distinct studies with their own premises. The present result does not add a new general gap in learning or require reopening its completed antecedents.
